text:
I count about 13 grapes: 12 red and 1 green. The plate is square and roughly 26 cm across, which puts each grape at about 2.5 cm long, or about 5-6 g. That gives roughly 13 × 5.5 ≈ 70 g.

Grapes run about 0.69 kcal/g, so 70 g is about 48 kcal. There is also a small piece of carrot, which adds very little.

Total is about 75 g and 50 kcal.
